title: Pulpo a la Gallega
description: A classic Spanish dish from the Galicia region, featuring tender grilled octopus served with potatoes and paprika.

ingredients.name: 1 lb pulpo (octopus)
ingredients.notes: Choose fresh, tender pulpo for best results

ingredients.name: 2 large potatoes, peeled
ingredients.notes: Spanish paprika adds depth to the dish

ingredients.name: 2 cups chestnut mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Add wine to pot for added flavor

ingredients.name: 2 tbsp olive oil
ingredients.notes: Garnish with parsley for a pop of color

instructions: 2. Cut pulpo into bite-sized pieces and season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
3. Grill pulpo until slightly charred, about 2-3 minutes per side.
5. In a separate pan, heat olive oil over medium heat.
6. Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
7. Add chestnut mushrooms and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
8. Add white wine to the pan and stir to combine.
9. To serve, place grilled pulpo on top of potatoes and garnish with parsley.
10. Serve immediately, enjoying the combination of flavors and textures.
